aboutdetail:
As part of our drive to make India greener and more sustainable, we are undertaking tree planting activities every day that contribute to the environment and help fight climate change. In this video, you will see our dedicated volunteers working together to plant trees, raise awareness in communities and encourage everyone to join us.
Together, we can make a difference! Let's make India greener
whycart1detail: We plant trees in new locations almost every day.
whycart2detail: Our dedicated team works to care for and maintain the planted trees.
whycart3detail: We don't just plant trees—we take care of them until they grow.
whycart4detail: All our activities are transparent and trustworthy.
whycart5detail: We continuously conduct tree plantation and environmental campaigns in Surat and nearby areas.
whycart6detail: We are committed to working in ways that do not harm the environment.
upcomingsubtitle: Join our community events and be a part of creating positive change.
upcomingcart1subtitle: Interactive learning sessions for youth covering STEM subjects, critical thinking, and skill development.
upcomingcart2subtitle: Join our volunteers for a tree plantation campaign along the banks of the Tapi River.
